judgement.reason: Baserow needs a separate Django backend server and a Nuxt web-frontend server running together behind a Caddy proxy, and Deployz runs only one web process per deployment.

evidence.quote: # This compose file runs every service separately using a Caddy reverse proxy to route
# requests to the backend or web-frontend, handle websockets and to serve uploaded files

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported architecture: docker-compose.yml defines 3 application services (backend, web-frontend, volume-permissions-fixer). Deployz runs ONE web process per deployment plus declared background workers.
reviews.reason: The production Dockerfile uses the all-in-one baserow image, and the shown lines do not prove that it runs as a single web process without the separate frontend and backend services.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unconfirmed service: the repository declares redis (redis:6) in docker-compose.yml. Deployz did not find how the application uses it.
reviews.reason: The declared service is Redis, which Deployz provides, and the configuration lets the app use an external Redis through REDIS_* settings.

evidence.quote: # Set these if you want to use an external redis instead of the redis service below.
